officialEvidence: Current Uattzy first-party site states Uattzy is the public-charging brand of UAU, an Italian company born from the union of E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia.
Current Uattzy first-party site states Uattzy acts as both CPO and eMSP and manages more than 3,000 charging points in Italy.

Current Uattzy FAQ states the direct Uattzy app/account shows the tariff at each connector before charging and that prices can vary according to delivered power, session duration and bay occupation time.
Current Uattzy FAQ supports app/RFID and, where enabled, QR/POS; roaming apps/cards can have separate operator pricing.

dedupDecision.reason: Corporate/brand succession is proven, but no deterministic evidence yet proves that all ESH/GAS EVSE identifiers have migrated to UTZ or that PUN/OCPI inventory should collapse the three partyIds into one canonical partyId. Merging now could hide live legacy identifiers or double-subtract physical EVSEs.
dedupDecision.safeHandling: Treat ESH/GAS/UTZ as one investigation family to avoid duplicated research, but preserve each observed partyId until EVSE-level migration/overlap is demonstrated.

tariffClassification.tariffChannel: direct Uattzy app/account; QR/POS where enabled; roaming eMSP separate
tariffClassification.rankableRequirement: deterministic EVSE/connector -> current Uattzy direct tariff mapping

negativePaths: No current first-party fixed network-wide EUR/kWh grid was found on the public Uattzy site or FAQ.
Third-party tariff observatories may be used only as discovery/corroboration and are not sufficient for direct-CPO rankable promotion.
Corporate union alone is not sufficient evidence to mark ESH or GAS as supersededAlias of UTZ.
familyReconciliations.resumeCondition: Inspect Uattzy app/public or guest backend, QR/POS endpoints and PUN/OCPI EVSE identifiers to establish whether ESH/GAS/UTZ overlap or have migrated and to obtain exact connector-level direct tariffs.
familyReconciliations.confidence: high corporate-family and station-level tariff model; unresolved partyId migration

queueImpact.researchDeduplication: ESH/GAS/UTZ now share one UAU/Uattzy investigation track

historyAppend: 2026-09-10 run106: reconciled ESH/GAS/UTZ as the UAU/Uattzy corporate family. Preserved partyIds separately pending EVSE-level migration proof; classified current Uattzy direct pricing as station/connector-level from first-party FAQ and prevented an unsafe alias merge.
